FULL TEXT:
FOREMAN (MOTOR CAR GARAGE) RECRUITMENT EXAMINATION, 2024
NOTICE
No.- 73/R&A Dated: 27th September, 2025
In continuation to this Court’s Notice No. 02/R&A dated 03.01.2025 and 58/R&A dated
08.08.2025, all concerned are hereby informed that Interview for appointment to the post of
Foreman (Motor Car Garage) in the establishment of this Court, under the Foreman (Motor
Car Garage) Recruitment Examination, 2024 (Advertisement No. PHC/03/2024 dated
28.05.2024), is scheduled to be held on 18th October 2025 (Saturday) in the premises of
Patna High Court.
The Admit card (Interview Letter) of the eligible candidates for appearing at the
interview shall be made available from 10.10.2025 onwards, on the official website of the High
Court i.e. https://patnahighcourt.gov.in.
The candidates are directed to strictly follow the schedule of interview and the
instructions mentioned in the Admit Card (Interview Letter). Requests for change in venue or
time of interview will not be entertained under any circumstances.
Admit card would not be sent to the candidates separately through any other mode. No
TA/DA will be paid for appearing at the test.
The candidates are advised to keep visiting the Court’s website regularly for further
details/ updates.
By order of the Court
Sd/- P. K. Malik
Registrar General
High Court of Judicature at Patna
